brief:
The Guardian published letters responding to Jonathan Freedland's analysis of Israeli electoral prospects, with Dr Richard Skues among those engaging with Freedland's argument that opposition parties cannot defeat Netanyahu without allying with Arab political groups.

Freedland's column examined the mechanics of Israeli coalition-building and the conditions necessary for an anti-Netanyahu majority to form government, prompting reader responses that explored the strategic and political implications of such potential alliances.

title: Readers debate Israeli opposition strategy ahead of elections
